slides.headline: Energy truce? [[Both sides cry foul.]]
bullets: **Overnight (PBS, Oct 15):** Ukrainian officials say Russia hit Kyiv with **850+ drones**. Not independently verified.
**Truce:** Trump announced an energy ceasefire Oct 11. Zelensky says Russia never kept it; Putin says Ukraine broke it first.
**Black Sea:** two cargo ships set on fire in Romanian waters, **7 crew missing** (PBS).
**Rift:** Zelensky says the US is limiting intelligence and Starlink support.
slides.sources: Sources: PBS NewsHour (Oct 15), AP. Claims by Zelensky, Putin and Ukrainian officials are unverified.

slides.headline: Today in [[4 numbers]]

stats.l: Drones fired at Kyiv overnight, per Ukrainian officials (claim)
Ship attacks near Hormuz since Oct 1, nearly double the war's monthly average
Killed in Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport Oct 7-11, per Saudi-led coalition (CBS reports 13 in one strike)
Palestinians killed in Gaza since the Oct 2025 ceasefire

slides.sources: Sources: PBS, CBS News, Fox News, UN News. Outlets differ on the Riyadh toll.

slides.headline: Palace hit. [[Ships burning.]]
bullets: **Aden (Oct 15):** Houthi missiles hit the presidential palace. 2 guards killed per Yemeni officials; 4 per government military sources (CBS, Fox).
**Hormuz:** CENTCOM says the IRGC struck container ship GFS Pride, which sank under tow; the IRGC claims a ship hit a mine. 10+ vessels hit since Oct 11.
**Medina:** coalition claims it downed a cruise missile; Houthis call that "a shameless and brazen lie."
slides.sources: Sources: CBS News, Fox News/Reuters, CENTCOM. IRGC, Houthi and coalition statements are claims.

slides.headline: Truce on paper. [[1,400+ dead]] since.
bullets: **UN Security Council (Oct 15):** more than **1,400 Palestinians** killed in Gaza since the Oct 2025 ceasefire. Aid access limited across 64% of Gaza's land (OCHA).
**Shelter:** IOM says supplies meet about **17%** of needs for 2.1 million people as winter nears.
**West Bank:** 1,600+ settler attacks recorded this year as of mid-September, **4,300+** Palestinians displaced (UN). Olive harvest under way.
**Lebanon:** Hezbollah admits seized explosives were its own (CBS). Israel's elections are Oct 27.
slides.sources: Sources: UN News (Oct 15), CBS News, Fox News. Israeli military comment on individual strikes not available.

slides.headline: Six children killed. [[Army plane blamed.]]
bullets: **Oct 15:** Emergency Lawyers Group says an army Antonov struck a home in Abu Zaima, North Kordofan: **5 children killed**, mother hurt. It says there were no military sites nearby. Army comment not found.
**West Kordofan:** a market strike near Wad Banda killed a child; a bombing in Al-Nuhud killed 1.
**Total:** 7 civilians incl. 6 children (Darfur24, local sources). Not independently verified.
slides.sources: Sources: Darfur24 (Oct 16), Emergency Lawyers Group. Single-source reports, unverified.

slides.headline: This [[week]]
bullets: **Ukraine:** whether the energy truce is formally dead; Kyiv-Washington rift over intelligence and Starlink.
**Iran/Gulf:** Trump's call on joining Saudi strikes on the Houthis; reported US strike options (CNN, unverified by Fox). Midterms Nov 3.
**Gaza/Lebanon:** winter shelter crisis; Israeli elections Oct 27.

caption_facebook:
WORLD AT WAR: Friday, Oct 16, 2026
4 fronts, 24 hours. Here's what changed.

🇺🇦 UKRAINE (Day 1,696)
• Ukrainian officials say Russia launched 850+ drones at Kyiv overnight (PBS; not independently verified).
• Trump announced an energy ceasefire on Oct 11. Zelensky says Russia never observed it; Putin says Ukraine violated it first. Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian refineries (AP).
• Two cargo ships were set on fire in Romanian waters of the Black Sea; seven crew are missing (PBS).
• Zelensky says the US is limiting intelligence and Starlink support.

🇮🇷 IRAN WAR (Day 231)
• Houthi missiles hit the presidential palace in Aden on Oct 15. Two security guards were killed per Yemeni officials; government military sources report four killed (Fox, CBS).
• Hormuz: CENTCOM says the IRGC struck container ship GFS Pride, which sank while being towed. Iran's IRGC claims a cargo ship hit a mine. 10+ vessels have been hit since Oct 11 and 23 attacks recorded since Oct 1, nearly double the war's monthly average (Vanguard/IMO/UKMTO via CBS). CENTCOM says 40+ ships crossed in 24 hours.
• Saudi-led coalition says Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport killed 17 and injured 333 between Oct 7-11 (CBS reported 13 killed in one strike). Coalition claims it downed a cruise missile over Medina; Houthis call that a lie.
• Brent crude ~$105 (Reuters). The EU-GCC summit set for Oct 24 is postponed.

🇵🇸 GAZA / WEST BANK
• UN Security Council (Oct 15): more than 1,400 Palestinians killed in Gaza since the Oct 2025 ceasefire; shelter supplies meet about 17% of needs (IOM).
• West Bank: 1,600+ settler attacks recorded this year as of mid-September; 4,300+ Palestinians displaced (UN).

🇸🇩 SUDAN
• Emergency Lawyers Group says a Sudanese army Antonov struck a home in Abu Zaima, North Kordofan, killing five children. Darfur24 reports 7 civilians, 6 of them children, killed across West and North Kordofan. Unverified; no army comment found.

WHAT TO WATCH: the fate of the Ukraine energy truce; US decision on the Houthis; Hormuz shipping.

Sources: PBS, CBS News, Fox News/Reuters, UN News, Darfur24. Figures are as reported by those outlets; warring-party claims are unverified.
